journey.title: How our eCommerce journey began
journey.description: Develo started as a passion for building websites and has grown into a specialist eCommerce agency focused on Magento, Adobe Commerce, and Hyva. From a two-person setup to a close-knit team, we combine creativity and technical expertise to support sustainable eCommerce growth.

item1.title: Transparency
item1.description: We're honest, straightforward, and easy to work with. Clear communication builds trust, and trust builds long-term relationships.

item2.title: Collaboration
item2.description: We work with you, not just for you. Your goals shape every decision, and your success is the benchmark for ours.

item3.title: Flexibility
item3.description: eCommerce changes quickly, and so do customer expectations. We adapt fast, stay proactive, and work hard to keep your store evolving long after it's launched.

item4.title: Curiosity
item4.description: We're always keen on exploring new ideas and testing new tools and technology. That curiosity keeps our work innovative and helps us deliver modern, high-performing Magento and eCommerce solutions.

item1.quote: I am continually impressed by the results you produced! Your unique perspective, expertise and dedication played a crucial role in our project success.

item2.quote: We were impressed with their knowledge of the Hyva theme and their efficiency in implementing it. Communication was great throughout the process and we are happy with the outcome and the impact this has had on our site speed.

item3.quote: Develo has truly become an extension of our team, consistently bringing proactive advice and innovative solutions that align perfectly with our objectives.

item4.quote: Feels like Develo is an extension of our internal team

item5.quote: We stock and sell some unusual products that require a lot of custom development. We've always been able to get what we want, no matter how complex it seemed.

item6.quote: Develo implemented the punchout2go module into our Magento installation with absolute precision. The integration was clean, fully compliant with our ERP procurement workflows, and performance has been rock solid.

item7.quote: Develo has meticulous attention to detail, coupled with a technically sound scope of work and supporting SoW, showcased their commitment to excellence. We value our partnership and would gladly choose to work with them again for future endeavours.

item8.quote: The team's knowledge and experience with Magento is invaluable. The website's speed and UX improved significantly, with page elements loading efficiently. The team was great at communicating different stages of the project and was always on hand when needed.

team.title: The eCommerce experts behind Develo
team.description: Our clients often tell us it feels like we're part of their own team, and that's exactly how we like to work. When you partner with us, you get direct access to the designers, developers, and strategists who take care of your store. No layers. No confusion. Just a friendly, highly skilled team focused on helping your eCommerce site perform at its best.
